title: Metrovpn v2.7.2 Update Available
message: Always launches elevated as Administrator with TUN Mode set as default, fixes TCP+TLS spoofed-SNI links without explicit VCN params, upgrades Screen QR capture to a mouse-drag Snipping Tool overlay, removes the Sample button, adds smooth neon telemetry lines with endpoint dots + smoother speedometer, and brings Android frosted glassmorphism.
